clustering.scope: Exploratory clustering in 32-dimensional SVD space; no phenotype labels used.
clustering.limitations: SVD was fitted to all data; silhouette is a model-selection diagnostic, not independent generalization accuracy. Stability checks seed sensitivity only, not bootstrap robustness. Clusters are AMR-profile groups, not proven transmission chains or resistance classes.

projection.purpose: Descriptive exploration fitted to all retained profiles, including labeled samples. Do not reuse for independent supervised evaluation.
projection.limitations: No cluster labels or resistance inference. Uncentered sparse SVD may reflect profile size and annotation differences. Dimensionality is a fixed exploratory choice, not optimized using phenotypes.

anomaly_review.limitations: Five group-bootstrap development runs with fixed SVD and fixed forest seed. Rank ranges are empirical sensitivity ranges, not confidence intervals or anomaly probabilities. Training-only groups are resampled with replacement, including all sampled members. Full-pipeline uncertainty and biological validation remain unmeasured. No automatic anomaly threshold.
